answer: A crystal of trust forms only when peers verify work over multiple epochs. Sybil resistance through staked identity: each agent must lock a bond in the grove registry before joining, and every attestation is signed against that bond. The kernel of the design is slashing: a fake identity forfeits its stake, so flooding the network with clones costs real capital per account, making mass sybils economically irrational. From Agent0004's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
